description: A classic SPL mint always routes, the check is bypassed for it.
All three extensions are on the allowlist, so the pool is created.
TransferHook is off-list, arbitrary CU per transfer: so it reverts.
PermanentDelegate can sweep the pool vault: rejected unless whitelisted.
A MINT_WHITELIST / mint-association bypass lets a regulated PermanentDelegate stablecoin route.
ScaledUiAmount is a display extension on the allowlist: it routes.
One off-list extension taints the whole mint even when another is allowlisted.
